theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+2.19%) and Health Care (+1.45%) led the market today, while Technology (-1.80%) and Utilities (-1.48%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.10%, defensives +0.41%, and value/cyclicals -0.91% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.48%, Dow -0.29%, Nasdaq -0.56% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.40%. The VIX rose 7.95% to 17.10, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.92% to $4,330.30, crude oil was little changed at $102.10, and bitcoin gained 1.93% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
